text:
Asha: Quick weekly check-in for Skymark onboarding — saw an error-rate shift in the last 24h, want to capture the breakdown and top failing endpoints so we can decide next steps. TL;DR: 5xx + request timeouts up, small rate-limit tail.

Ben: Numbers? rough percent changes and which endpoints?

Asha: 24h vs baseline (7d avg): total requests +12%, errors +3.8pp. Breakdown: 5xx = 2.6pp increase, timeouts = 0.9pp increase, rate-limited = 0.3pp. Attaching quick paste of top failing routes below.

svc-monitor-bot: alert: skymark-prod - error rate > 3% for 10m window (triggered at 2026-02-18T11:04Z)

Asha: Top failing endpoints (by failure count):
- /v1/generate (model-run): 67% of 5xx (mostly 503/524)
- /v1/embeddings (bulk): 18% of timeouts (client aborts + upstream timeout)
- /v1/chat (small messages): 9% rate-limited spikes during peak bursts
- /v1/prompt/validate: 6% intermittent 5xx (schema lambda)

Tom: Any recent deploys or config changes for Skymark?

Asha: No customer-side changes reported. We pushed a minor runtime config tweak yesterday (KV cache eviction policy) to the pool that serves the onboarding batch. Might be related.

Priya: Can you paste the failing log samples?

Asha: Paste logs (redacted) — main patterns: service-level 503 with "model not ready", and upstream 524 timeouts.

```
[v1/generate] 2026-02-18T10:42:13Z request_id=abc123 model=gpt-xv2 status=503 msg="model not ready" pool=dedicated-4
[v1/embeddings] 2026-02-18T10:50:02Z request_id=def456 batch_size=128 latency=30s err=timeout upstream=kv-cache-lookup
[v1/chat] 2026-02-18T11:00:05Z request_id=ghi789 rate_limit=burst limit=60/min dropped=12
```

Asha: Quick hypothesis: the KV cache eviction change increased cold-starts for long-context generation -> extra model load attempts -> transient 503s and increased tail. Bulk embedding timeouts align with larger batch shapes hitting memory/exec path. Rate-limit tail is separate, bursty client behavior during onboarding demo sessions.

Tom: I'll open an eng-runtime ticket and add logs. Can you share pinpointed sample request IDs for the highest-volume 503s so we can trace kernel selection?

Asha: Will drop top 10 request_ids into the ticket. For immediate mitigation, recommend: 1) roll back the KV eviction tweak for the affected pool, 2) temp lower batch_size for embeddings route, 3) add short throttling for chat demo client IDs.

Ben: Sounds good. Timeline?

Asha: Tom, any chance eng-runtime can triage within 2-3 hours? If not we'll rollback tomorrow morning.

Tom: Can do triage now. I'll create INC-2329, tag @eng-runtime and @infra.

svc-monitor-bot: incident created: INC-2329 by Tom — https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2329

Priya: I'll coordinate with Skymark CSM to pause heavy demos and ask for any anomalous client-side retries.

Asha: I'll post a short note to the customer: "We're investigating an increase in request errors; we may throttle demos temporarily to stabilize. Will update in 2 hours."

Ben: Thanks — please ping when we have rollback or confirmed fix. :thumbsup:

Asha: Will do. Adding follow-ups: collect top 50 request_ids, perf profile pool, and update the weekly health doc.

Tom: Assigned ENG action items in INC-2329.

Priya: CSM notified Skymark. They reported one large batch job yesterday at 09:50 UTC, possible root cause.

Asha: Good catch — please ask for job shape (batch size, seq len). I'll add it to the ticket.

Ben: Ok team, let's reconvene in 90 minutes.

Asha: Reconvene @ 12:30 UTC. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
